name: Cabin Crew Recruitment ATS

pages.name: SignupPage
pages.description: Public self-signup page for Candidates. Collects full name, email, password, and nationality. On submit creates a User record with role=candidate and an empty CandidateProfile.

pages.name: ApplyPage

fields.name: rightToWorkDeclaration
fields.label: I confirm I have the right to work in the target country

fields.name: medicalFitnessDeclaration
fields.label: I declare I am medically fit to perform cabin crew duties (EASA Part-CC baseline)

pages.description: Multi-step wizard for Candidates to complete their aviation-compliant profile and upload their CV. Step 1: personal details (DOB, passport, right-to-work, medical and swimming declarations). Step 2: experience (total years, aviation years, previous airlines, education). Step 3: CV file upload. On completion the CV is queued for AI parsing via ParseAndAggregateCV workflow.

pages.name: PipelinePage
pages.description: Recruiter pipeline board for a specific Drive. Columns represent application statuses: Applied, Shortlisted, Interview Scheduled, Offered, Rejected. Each card shows candidate name, aggregation score, nationality, and aviation experience years. Recruiter can drag cards or use action buttons to shortlist or reject.

pages.name: DriveSchedulePage
pages.description: Recruiter interview scheduling view for a Drive. Left panel lists shortlisted candidates for the Drive. Right panel is a resource-schedule grid with rows per shortlisted candidate and columns per day, showing interview slots. Recruiter clicks an empty cell to open a booking form (candidate pre-filled, date/time, stage, duration, location, interview type). On save, ScheduleInterview workflow fires.

pages.name: InterviewPage
pages.description: Recruiter interview conduction page. Shows candidate profile summary (photo, aggregation score, CV highlights, aviation experience, language skills, compliance declarations). Below is a structured interview guide with aviation competency question prompts grouped by competency area. Recruiter takes live notes. Bottom bar links to Submit Feedback Scorecard.

pages.name: FeedbackScorecardPage

fields.name: physicalFitnessDeclarationConfirmed
fields.label: Physical Fitness Declaration Confirmed by Recruiter

pages.description: Aviation-aligned feedback scorecard form. Scores (1-5) for: Grooming & Presentation, English Language Proficiency, Secondary Language Proficiency, Safety Awareness, Customer Service Orientation, Crew Resource Management Aptitude, Cultural Fit. Boolean for Physical Fitness Declaration Confirmed. Overall Recommendation dropdown (Proceed / Hold / Reject). Compliance Notes textarea. Additional Comments textarea. On submit, SubmitFeedbackScorecard workflow persists the scorecard and notifies the candidate.

pages.name: CandidateDashboardPage
pages.description: Candidate home dashboard. Shows application status timeline per Drive applied to, CV parse status indicator, aggregation score badge, upcoming interview schedule widget, and notification inbox preview.

pages.name: RecruiterDashboardPage
pages.description: Recruiter home dashboard. KPI tiles: total active Drives, total applications this month, shortlisted count, interviews scheduled today. Recent activity feed. Quick-access buttons to create a new Drive or view pipeline.

pages.name: DrivesListPage
pages.description: Recruiter list of all Drives. Columns: title, location, status, start date, end date, headcount target, application count. Filters by status (Draft, Active, Closed). Actions: Create Drive, View Pipeline, Edit, Archive.

pages.name: DriveFormPage
pages.description: Form to create a new recruitment Drive. Fields: title, description, location, target headcount, start date, end date. On save, three default DriveStages are seeded (Initial Screening, Group Exercise, Final Interview).

pages.name: DriveDetailPage
pages.description: Drive detail page showing Drive metadata, stages list (Initial Screening, Group Exercise, Final Interview), application statistics per stage, and quick links to Pipeline and Schedule views.

pages.name: CandidateProfilePage
pages.description: Full candidate profile view for Recruiters. Sections: personal details, compliance declarations (passport validity, right-to-work, medical fitness, swimming), aviation experience, language skills, education, CV parse summary with aggregation score, and application history across Drives with scorecards.

pages.name: CandidatesListPage
pages.description: Recruiter searchable list of all candidates in the system. Columns: name, nationality, aggregation score, aviation experience years, CV parse status, date applied. Filters: aggregation score range, experience years, language. Click row to open CandidateProfilePage.

pages.name: InterviewCalendarPage
pages.description: Recruiter calendar view of all scheduled interviews across all Drives. Month/week toggle. Events color-coded by Drive. Click event to open interview detail. Sidebar shows today's interviews list.

pages.name: NotificationsPage
pages.description: Unified notification inbox for both Candidates and Recruiters. Left pane lists notifications (title, time, read/unread badge). Right reading pane shows body and a link to the related entity (Drive, Application, Interview).

pages.name: AnalyticsPage
pages.description: Recruitment analytics for Recruiters. KPIs: total applications, shortlist rate, offer rate, average aggregation score. Charts: applications by month, applications by Drive, funnel by status stage, recommendation distribution (Proceed/Hold/Reject) from scorecards, average score by competency area.

pages.name: SettingsPage
pages.description: Account settings page. Sections: profile (name, email, avatar), password change, notification preferences (email and in-app toggles per event type).

workflows.name: ParseAndAggregateCV

config.prompt: Extract the following fields from the uploaded CV document: totalExperienceYears, aviationExperienceYears, previousAirlines (list), primaryLanguage, secondaryLanguages (list), educationLevel, certifications (list). Return as structured JSON.

Given the candidate profile fields (aviationExperienceYears, totalExperienceYears, educationLevel, primaryLanguage, secondaryLanguages count, swimmingProficiency, medicalFitnessDeclaration, rightToWorkDeclaration), compute a weighted aggregation score from 0 to 100 aligned with IATA cabin crew baseline requirements. Return a single integer.

config.message: Your CV has been parsed and your profile is now ready. Your aggregation score has been computed. You can now apply to open Drives.
Welcome to the Cabin Crew ATS. Your CV aggregation is complete. Log in to view your profile and apply to open recruitment Drives.

workflows.description: Triggered when a Candidate submits their application with a CV file. Extracts structured aviation-relevant fields from the CV using AI, persists the parsed data to the CandidateProfile, computes an aggregation score, then notifies the candidate that their profile is ready.

assumptions: What aviation-specific fields should appear on the feedback scorecard — resolved: Scorecard includes Grooming & Presentation, Language Proficiency (English + secondary), Safety Awareness, Customer Service Orientation, Crew Resource Management aptitude, Cultural Fit, Physical Fitness Declaration, and Overall Recommendation (Proceed / Hold / Reject). This aligns with IATA cabin crew competency standards.

Are there multiple stages within a Drive — resolved: A Drive contains three ordered stages: Initial Screening, Group Exercise, and Final Interview. Each stage is modelled as a DriveStage record; a Candidate's ApplicationStatus tracks progress per stage. This matches typical airline recruitment event structure.

Who creates and manages Drives — resolved: Recruiters create and manage Drives on the platform. There is no separate Admin role; the Recruiter actor owns Drive CRUD. This avoids adding an undeclared actor while keeping management capabilities practical.

Is there a CV scoring or ranking step after aggregation — resolved: After AI parsing, the system computes an automatic AggregationScore (0-100) based on weighted aviation-relevant fields (experience, language, education). The score is surfaced on the pipeline page as a ranking aid; Recruiters still make the final shortlist decision manually.

Can Candidates apply to multiple Drives simultaneously — resolved: Yes. A DriveApplication join entity tracks each Candidate-Drive combination independently with its own status, stage, and score. This is standard ATS behaviour and supports concurrent recruitment campaigns.

Is there a notification or communication workflow — resolved: Yes. Candidates receive an email + in-app notification upon (a) CV parse completion, (b) shortlisting, and (c) interview scheduling. Recruiters receive an in-app notification when a new application arrives for one of their Drives.

Are there compliance or regulatory data requirements specific to aviation — resolved: Candidate profiles capture passport validity, right-to-work declaration, medical fitness self-declaration, and swimming proficiency (EASA/IATA cabin crew baseline requirements). Feedback Scorecards include a regulatory compliance note field. No full EASA Part-CC medical form is generated, but the fields are captured for downstream HR use.
description: An Applicant Tracking System purpose-built for aviation cabin crew recruitment. Candidates upload CVs that are parsed and aggregated; recruiters shortlist candidates, schedule interviews within recruitment Drives, and submit aviation-aligned feedback scorecards.
